paragraphs: On January 3, 2017, HGV became an independent publicly traded company as a result of Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc.'s ("Hilton") tax-free spin-off of each of HGV and Park Hotels & Resorts Inc. ("Park"). HGV's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "HGV." Following the spin-off, Hilton did not retain any ownership in HGV. In connection with the spin-off, we entered into agreements with Hilton and other third parties, including licenses to use the Hilton Grand Vacations brand. For more information regarding these agreements, see "—Business—Agreements with Hilton Worldwide Holdings."

On August 2, 2021, we completed the acquisition of Dakota Holdings, Inc. ("Diamond"), the parent of Diamond Resorts International (the "Diamond Acquisition"), by exchanging 100% of the outstanding equity interests of Diamond for shares of HGV common stock. As a result of the Diamond Acquisition, certain funds controlled by Apollo Global Management Inc. ("Apollo") and other minority shareholders, which previously owned 100% of Diamond, held 28% of HGV's common stock at the time the Diamond Acquisition was completed.

On January 17, 2024 (the "Bluegreen Acquisition Date"), we completed the acquisition of Bluegreen Vacations Holding Corporation (the "Bluegreen Acquisition") in an all-cash transaction, with total consideration of $1.6 billion, inclusive of net debt.

We are a global timeshare company engaged in developing, marketing, selling, managing and operating timeshare resorts, timeshare plans and ancillary reservation services, primarily under the Hilton Grand Vacations brands. Our operations primarily consist of: selling VOIs for us and third parties; financing and servicing loans provided to consumers for their VOI purchases; operating resorts and timeshare plans; and managing our exchange programs through which members may receive HGV Max benefits. Together our timeshare plans and exchange programs are collectively referred to as "Clubs".

As of December 31, 2025, we have over 200 properties located in the United States ("U.S."), Europe, Canada, the Caribbean, Mexico, and Asia. A significant number of our properties and VOIs are concentrated in Florida, Europe, Hawaii, South Carolina, California, Arizona, Nevada, and Virginia. We have rebranded many of the properties acquired in the Diamond Acquisition, and we expect to continue this process for the remaining planned Diamond properties. During 2025, we began rebranding certain properties acquired in the Bluegreen Acquisition to Hilton Grand Vacations brands and expect to continue this process for the majority of the Bluegreen properties.

As of December 31, 2025, we had more than 720,000 members across our Club offerings. Based on the type of Club membership, members have the flexibility to exchange their VOIs for stays at Hilton Grand Vacations resorts, properties in the Hilton system of 25 industry-leading brands with over 9,000 properties, or affiliated properties, as well as numerous experiential vacation options, such as cruises and guided tours, or they have the option to exchange their VOI for various other timeshare resorts throughout the world through an external exchange program, including travel services options.

Our compelling VOI product allows customers to advance purchase a lifetime of vacations. Because our VOI owners generally purchase only the vacation time they intend to use each year, they are able to efficiently split the full cost of owning and maintaining a vacation residence with other owners. Our customers also benefit from the amenities and service at our resorts. Furthermore, our points-based platform offers members tremendous flexibility, enabling us to more effectively adapt to their changing vacation needs over time. Building on the strength of that platform, we continuously seek new ways to add value to our Club memberships, including enhanced product offerings, greater geographic distribution, broader exchange networks and further technological innovation, all of which drive better, more personalized vacation experiences and guest satisfaction.

As innovators in the timeshare business, we enhance our inventory strategy by developing an inventory mix focused on developed properties as well as fee-for-service and just-in-time agreements to sell VOIs on behalf of or acquired from third-party developers.
We operate our business across two segments: (1) Real estate sales and financing and (2) Resort operations and club management.
Our real estate sales and financing segment primarily generates revenue from:

•VOI Sales—We sell our owned inventory and interests directly and, through our fee-for-service agreements, we sell VOIs on behalf of third-party developers using the Hilton Grand Vacations brand in exchange for fee-for-service commissions and brand fees. Under these fee-for-service agreements, we earn commission fees based on a percentage of total contract sales. See "—Inventory and Development Activities" and "—Marketing and Sales Activities" below for additional information.

•Financing—We provide consumer financing, which includes interest income generated from the origination of consumer loans to members to finance their purchase of VOIs owned by us. We also generate fee revenue from servicing the loans provided by third-party developers to purchasers of their VOIs. See "—Financing Activities" below for additional information regarding our consumer financing activities.
Our resort operations and club management segment primarily generates revenue from:

•Resort Management—Our resort management services primarily consist of operating properties under management agreements for the benefit of homeowners' associations ("HOAs") of VOI owners at both our resorts and those developed by third parties. Our management agreements with HOAs provide for a cost-plus management fee, which means we generally earn a fee equal to 10% to 15% of the costs to operate the applicable resort. See "—Resort and Club Management Activities" below for additional information regarding our resort management activities.

headings: Macroeconomic and other factors beyond our control can adversely affect and reduce demand for our products and services.
Contraction in the global economy or low levels of economic growth could adversely affect our revenues and profitability as well as limit or slow our future growth.
We operate in a highly competitive industry.
Risks Related to the Operation of Our Business
We do not own the Hilton brands and our business will be materially harmed if we breach our license agreement with Hilton or it is terminated.
We will rely on Hilton to consent to our use of its trademarks at new properties we manage in the future.
Our business depends on the quality and reputation of the Hilton brands and affiliation with the Hilton Honors loyalty program.
We rely on several critical marketing programs and activities to generate tour flow and contract sales and increase our revenues.
We may experience financial and operational risks in connection with acquisitions and other opportunistic business ventures.
Our dependence on development activities exposes us to project cost and completion risks.
Our real estate investments subject us to numerous risks.
We rely on highly skilled personnel and, if we are unable to retain or motivate key personnel, hire qualified personnel, or maintain our corporate culture, we may not be able to grow effectively.
Third-party reservation channels may negatively affect our bookings for room rental revenues.
Our insurance policies may not cover all potential losses.
Our business could be adversely impacted if we have deficiencies in our disclosure controls and procedures, including as a result of the material weakness identified by management.
Risks Related to the Sale of VOIs
A decline in developed or acquired VOI inventory may have an adverse effect on our business or results of operations.
Our ability to source VOI inventory and finance VOI sales may be impaired if we or the third-party developers with whom we do business are unable to access capital when necessary.
The sale of VOIs in the secondary market by existing members could cause our sales revenues and profits to decline.
If the default rates or other credit metrics underlying our timeshare financing receivables deteriorate, our timeshare financing receivable securitization program could be adversely affected.
The expiration, termination or renegotiation of our management agreements could adversely affect our cash flows, revenues and profits.
Fraudulent or illegal activity related to the sale and purchase of timeshares may deter consumers from purchasing our product.
Increased activity by third-party exit companies' owners may adversely impact our business.
Disagreements with VOI owners, HOAs and other third parties may result in litigation and/or loss of management contracts.
Failure of HOA boards to levy sufficient fees, or the failure of members to pay those fees, could lead to inadequate funds to maintain or improve the properties we manage.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes that appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations is for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared with the year ended December 31, 2024. Discussions of our financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to December 31, 2023 that have been omitted under this item can be found in Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, which was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 3, 2025.

This disclosure includes forward-looking statements; and actual results and events may differ substantially from those discussed or highlighted in these forward-looking statements. See "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

We are a global timeshare company engaged in developing, marketing, selling, managing and operating timeshare resorts, timeshare plans and ancillary reservation services, primarily under the Hilton Grand Vacations brand. During 2021, we completed the Diamond Acquisition, and on January 17, 2024, we completed the Bluegreen Acquisition.

Our operations primarily consist of: selling VOIs for us and third parties; financing and servicing loans provided to consumers for their VOI purchases; operating resorts and timeshare plans; and managing our exchange programs through which our members may receive HGV Max benefits. Together our timeshare plans and exchange programs are collectively referred to as "Clubs".

As of December 31, 2025, we have over 200 properties located in the United States ("U.S."), Europe, Canada, the Caribbean, Mexico and Asia. A significant number of our properties and VOIs are concentrated in Florida, Europe, Hawaii, South Carolina, California, Arizona, Nevada and Virginia. Our properties feature spacious, condominium-style accommodations with superior amenities and quality service. We have rebranded many of the Diamond properties, and we expect to continue this process for a majority of the remaining Diamond properties. During 2025, we began rebranding certain Bluegreen properties to Hilton Grand Vacation brands. We anticipate rebranding the majority of the Bluegreen properties to meet Hilton brand standards.

As of December 31, 2025, we had more than 720,000 members across our club offerings. Based on the type of Club membership, members have the flexibility to exchange their VOIs for stays at Hilton Grand Vacations resorts, properties in the Hilton system of 25 industry-leading brands with over 9,000 properties, or affiliated properties, as well as numerous experiential vacation options, such as cruises and guided tours, or they have the option to exchange their VOI for various other timeshare resorts throughout the world through an external exchange program, including travel services options.
We operate our business across two segments: (1) real estate sales and financing; and (2) resort operations and club management.

Traditionally, timeshare operators have funded 100% of the investment necessary to acquire land and construct timeshare properties. We source VOIs through developed properties and fee-for-service and just-in-time agreements with third-party developers and have focused our inventory strategy on developing an optimal inventory mix. The fee-for-service agreements enable us to generate fees from the sales and marketing of the VOIs and Club memberships and from the management of the timeshare properties without requiring us to fund acquisition and construction costs. The just-in-time agreements enable us to source VOI inventory in a manner that allows us to correlate the timing of acquisition of the inventory with the sale to purchasers. Sales of owned, including just-in-time, inventory generally result in greater Adjusted EBITDA contributions, while fee-for-service sales require less initial investment and allow us to accelerate our sales growth. Both sales of owned inventory and fee-for-service sales generate long-term, predictable fee streams, by adding to the Club membership base and properties under management, that generate strong returns on invested capital.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, sales from fee-for-service and just-in-time inventory were 17% and 9% of contract sales, respectively. See "Key Business and Financial Metrics—Real Estate Sales Operating Metrics" for additional discussion of contract sales. The estimated contract sales value related to our inventory that is currently available for sale or will be made available for sale in the future at planned projects is $14.7 billion at current pricing. Capital-efficient arrangements, comprised of our fee-for-service and just-in-time inventory, represented 35% of that supply. We believe that the visibility into our long-term supply allows us to efficiently manage inventory to meet predicted sales, reduce capital investments, minimize our exposure to the cyclicality of the real estate market and mitigate the risks of entering into new markets.

We sell our vacation ownership products primarily through our distribution network of both-in-market and off-site sales centers. Our products are currently marketed for sale throughout the United States, Europe, Canada, Mexico and Asia. We operate sales distribution centers in major markets and popular leisure destinations with year-round demand and a history of being a friendly environment for vacation ownership. We have over 100 sales distribution centers in various domestic and international locations. Our marketing and sales activities are based on targeted direct marketing and a highly personalized sales approach. We use targeted direct marketing to reach potential members who are identified as having the financial ability to pay for our products, are frequent leisure travelers, and have an affinity with our brands.

Tour flow quality impacts key metrics such as close rate and VPG, defined in "Key Business and Financial Metrics—Real Estate Sales Operating Metrics." Additionally, the quality of tour flow impacts sales revenue and the collectability of our timeshare financing receivables. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, 74%, 72% and 70% of our contract sales were to our existing owners.

We provide financing for members purchasing our developed and acquired inventory and generate interest income on the loans. Our timeshare financing receivables are collateralized by the underlying VOIs and are generally structured as 10-year, fully amortizing loans that bear a fixed interest rate typically ranging from 2.5% to 25% per annum. Financing propensity was 67% for both of the years ended December 31, 2025, and 2024. We calculate financing propensity as contract sales volume of financed contracts originated in the period divided by contract sales volume originated in the period.

headings: 度假村與俱樂部管理活動
與 Hilton Worldwide Holdings 之協議
paragraphs: 於2017年1月3日，HGV成為一家獨立上市的公司，這是因為Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc.（"Hilton"）以稅務無負擔的方式將HGV與Park Hotels & Resorts Inc.（"Park"）分拆出去。HGV的普通股在紐約證券交易所上市，代碼為"HGV"。分拆後，Hilton不再持有HGV的任何股權。與分拆相關，我們與Hilton及其他第三方簽訂了協議，包括使用Hilton Grand Vacations品牌的許可證。如需瞭解這些協議的更多資訊，請參閱"—業務—與Hilton Worldwide Holdings的協議。"

於2021年8月2日，我們完成了對Dakota Holdings, Inc.（"Diamond"）的收購，而Diamond為Diamond Resorts International的母公司（"Diamond收購"），我們以交換100%的Diamond現有權益為條件，換取HGV普通股。由於Diamond收購，由Apollo Global Management Inc.（"Apollo"）及其他少數股東控制的資金，先前擁有100%的Diamond股權，於收購完成時持有HGV普通股的28%。
於2024年1月17日（"Bluegreen收購日"），我們以現金方式完成了對Bluegreen Vacations Holding Corporation（"Bluegreen收購"）的收購，總對價為16億美元，包含淨負債。

我們是一家全球性時尚度假公司，從事開發、行銷、銷售、管理和運營時尚度假飯店、時尚度假計劃及相關預訂服務，主要使用Hilton Grand Vacations品牌。我們的業務主要包括：為我們及第三方銷售VOIs；為消費者提供貸款 financing 及貸款服務，用以購買VOIs；運營度假飯店及時尚度假計劃；以及管理我們的交換計畫，讓會員可以獲得HGV Max好處。我們的時尚度假計劃及交換計畫 collectively 稱為"Clubs"。

截至2025年12月31日，我們在美國（"U.S."）、歐洲、加拿大、加勒比海、墨西哥及亞洲擁有超過200處不動產。我們的許多不動產及VOIs集中在佛羅裏達州、歐洲、夏威夷、南卡羅來納州、加州、亞利桑那州、內華達州及維吉尼亞州。我們已重新品牌許多在Diamond收購中取得的不動產，並預期會繼續進行此過程，以處理預計的其他Diamond不動產。在2025年，我們開始重新品牌部分在Bluegreen收購中取得的不動產為Hilton Grand Vacations品牌，並預期會繼續進行此過程，以處理大多數Bluegreen不動產。

截至2025年12月31日，我們在Club產品中擁有超過72萬名會員。根據Club會員類型，會員可以靈活地將其VOIs交換為在Hilton Grand Vacations度假飯店的住宿，或在Hilton系統內的25個行業領導品牌中擁有超過9,000處不動產的住宿，或與Hilton有關係的不動產，以及多種體驗式度假選擇，例如郵輪與導覽行程，或他們也可以選擇將其VOI交換為世界各地的其他時尚度假飯店，透過外部交換計畫，包括旅行服務選擇。

我們有吸引力的VOI產品讓客戶可以預先購買一輩子的度假。因為我們的VOI所有者通常只購買他們每年預期使用的度假時間，因此他們可以有效地與其他所有者共同分擔擁有及維護度假住宅的全部成本。我們的客戶也受益於我們度假飯店的設施與服務。此外，我們的點數制度平台為會員提供極大的靈活性，使我們能更有效地適應他們變動的度假需求。基於該平台的強大，我們持續尋求新的方法來提升Club會員的價值，包括增強產品選擇、更廣的地理分佈、更廣的交換網路及進一步的科技創新，這些都推動了更優質、更個性化的度假體驗與顧客滿意度。
作為時尚度假產業的創新者，我們透過發展一個以開發不動產為重點的庫存策略，以及費用服務及即時協議，來銷售VOIs，為第三方開發商或取得的不動產進行銷售。
本公司營運業務分為兩大應報告分部：(1) 不動產銷售與融資，以及(2) 度假村營運與俱樂部管理。
本公司不動產銷售與融資應報告分部主要營收來源為：
•VOI銷售—本公司直接銷售本公司所擁有之存貨及權益，並透過本公司收費服務協議，代表第三方開發商銷售VOI，使用Hilton Grand Vacations品牌，並收取收費服務佣金及品牌費用。根據這些收費服務協議，本公司根據總契約銷售額百分比收取佣金費用。有關本公司存貨與開發活動及市場行銷與銷售活動之更多資訊，請參閱下方「—存貨與開發活動」及「—市場行銷與銷售活動」。
•融資—本公司提供消費者融資，包含因向會員貸款以資助其購買本公司所擁有VOI而產生之利息收入。本公司亦因服務第三方開發商所提供給VOI購買新屋之貸款而產生費用收入。有關本公司消費者融資活動之更多資訊，請參閱下方「—融資活動」。
本公司度假村營運與俱樂部管理應報告分部主要營收來源為：
•度假村營運管理—本公司度假村營運管理服務主要為為VOI所有者之住宅所有權人協會（"HOAs"）管理度假村之營運，包括本公司度假村及第三方開發之度假村。本公司與HOAs之管理協議規定為成本加成管理費用，即本公司通常根據營運相關度假村之成本百分比收取10%至15%之費用。有關本公司度假村營運管理活動之更多資訊，請參閱下方「—度假村與俱樂部管理活動」。

以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，係針對 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度比較。有關 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度，與 2023 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度比較之財務狀況及營運成果之討論，因本項目已省略，可參閱 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度年報第 10-K 表格所附之 "管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析" 部分，該部分已於 2025 年 3 月 3 日向證券交易委員會提交。

本公司為一全球性時段度假公司，從事開發、行銷、銷售、管理及營運時段度假飯店、時段度假計畫及相關預訂服務，主要以 Hilton Grand Vacations 品牌為主。2021 年，本公司完成 Diamond 收購，並於 2024 年 1 月 17 日完成 Bluegreen 收購。
本公司營運主要包含：為本公司及第三方銷售 VOIs；為消費者提供 VOI 購買貸款之融資及服務；營運飯店及時段度假計畫；以及管理我們的交換計畫，使會員可獲得 HGV Max 福利。我們的時段度假計畫與交換計畫合稱為 "俱樂部"。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司於美國（"美國"）、歐洲、加拿大、加勒比海、墨西哥及亞洲擁有超過 200 處不動產。我們的不動產及 VOIs 有相當數量集中於佛羅裏達州、歐洲、夏威夷、南卡羅來納州、加州、亞利桑那州、內華達州及維吉尼亞州。我們的不動產提供寬敞、公寓式住宿，並具備優越的設施與高品質服務。我們已重新品牌許多 Diamond 不動產，並預期會持續進行此過程，以處理剩餘的大部分 Diamond 不動產。2025 年，我們開始將部分 Bluegreen 不動產重新品牌為 Hilton Grand Vacations 品牌。我們預期會重新品牌大多數 Bluegreen 不動產，以符合 Hilton 品牌標準。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司於各俱樂部方案中擁有超過 72 萬名會員。根據俱樂部會員類型，會員可選擇將其 VOIs 交換為入住 Hilton Grand Vacations 酒店，或於 Hilton 系統內 25 個行業領導品牌中擁有超過 9,000 處不動產，或相關不動產，以及眾多體驗式假期選擇，例如郵輪與導覽之旅，或選擇將其 VOI 交換為世界各地其他時段度假飯店，透過外部交換計畫，包括旅行服務選擇。
本公司營運分為兩大分部：(1) 不動產銷售與融資；及 (2) 酒店營運與俱樂部管理。

傳統上，時段度假權經營者會自行負擔100%的投資，用以取得土地並興建時段度假權財產。我們透過已開發的財產及第三方開發商的費用服務及即時協議取得VOIs，並著重於存貨策略的發展，以建立最佳的存貨組合。費用服務協議使我們能透過銷售及行銷VOIs及俱樂部會員資格，以及管理時段度假權財產，產生費用收入，而無需負擔取得及興建成本。即時協議使我們能以一種方式取得VOI存貨，使我們能將存貨取得的時間與銷售給買方的時間相對應。自有存貨的銷售，包括即時存貨，通常會產生更高的調整後營運資金貢獻，而費用服務銷售則需要較少的初始投資，並使我們能加速銷售成長。自有存貨銷售及費用服務銷售都會產生長期且可預測的費用流，透過增加俱樂部會員數量及管理中的財產，產生強勁的投資回報。

截至2025年12月31日年度，費用服務及即時存貨的銷售分別佔合約銷售額的17%及9%。有關合約銷售額的進一步討論，請參閱「關鍵業務與財務指標—不動產銷售營運指標」。目前可供銷售或將來預計可供銷售的存貨，其預估合約銷售價值為147億美元，以目前價格計算。由我們的費用服務及即時存貨組成的資本效率協議，佔該供應量的35%。我們相信，對我們長期供應的可見度使我們能有效管理存貨，以符合預測銷售，減少資本投資，降低對不動產市場週期性的暴露，並緩解進入新市場的風險。

我們主要透過分佈於市場內及市場外的銷售中心來銷售我們的度假權產品。我們的產品目前在美國、歐洲、加拿大、墨西哥及亞洲進行行銷與銷售。我們在主要市場及熱門休閒目的地運營銷售分佈中心，這些地方有全年需求，且有悠久的友好環境供度假權的歷史。我們在各國內外擁有超過100個銷售分佈中心。我們的行銷與銷售活動基於針對性的直接行銷及高度個性化的銷售方式。我們透過針對性的直接行銷來接觸潛在會員，這些會員被識別為具有購買我們產品的財力、頻繁休閒旅行，且對我們品牌有親近感。
旅遊流量品質會影響關鍵指標，如成交率及VPG，這些指標在「關鍵業務與財務指標—不動產銷售營運指標」中定義。此外，旅遊流量品質也會影響銷售收入及我們時段度假權融資應收款的可收回性。截至2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日年度，我們的合約銷售額中有74%、72%及70%來自現有會員。
我們為購買我們已開發及取得存貨的會員提供融資，並從貸款中產生利息收入。我們的時段度假權融資應收款由相關的VOIs擔保，通常結構為10年期、完全償還貸款，利率為年利率2.5%至25%之間。截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日年度，融資意願為67%。我們計算融資意願為該期間內融資合約的合約銷售額除以該期間內所有合約的合約銷售額。
我們貸款的利率由多種因素決定，包括預付金額、借款人的信用評分及貸款期限。貸款於發放時，美國及加拿大借款人的加權平均FICO分數如下：

headings: 與我們產業相關的風險
總體經濟及其他超出我們控制範疇的因素可能不利於我們產品與服務的需求，並降低需求量。
全球經濟收縮或經濟成長率偏低可能不利於我們的營業收入與獲利，同時也可能限制或減緩我們未來的成長。
我們所處的產業為高度競爭的產業。
與我們業務運作相關的風險
本公司不擁有希爾頓品牌，若我們違反與希爾頓的授權協議或協議終止，將會對我們的業務造成重大損害。
我們將依賴希爾頓同意我們在未來管理的新飯店使用其商標。
我們的業務取決於希爾頓品牌之品質與聲譽，以及與希爾頓榮耀忠誠計畫之合作關係。
我們依賴數個關鍵性行銷計畫與活動，以產生旅遊人潮與合約銷售，並提高我們的營業收入。
我們可能因併購及其他機會性商業計畫而面臨財務與營運風險。
我們對開發活動之依賴，使我們面臨項目成本與完工風險。
我們的不動產投資使我們面臨眾多風險。
我們依賴高素質之專業人員，若我們無法留住或激勵關鍵人員、聘僱合格人員，或維持本公司企業文化，我們可能無法有效成長。
第三方預訂管道可能對我們的客房租賃收入預訂產生負面影響。
本公司之保險政策可能無法涵蓋所有潛在損失。
若本公司之揭露控管及程序存在缺陷，包括因管理層所識別之重大缺陷所致，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
與銷售 VOIs 有關之風險
已開發或取得之 VOI 存貨減少，可能對本公司業務或營運成果造成不利影響。
若本公司或與本公司從事業務之第三方開發者無法在必要時取得資金，則本公司取得 VOI 存貨及融資 VOI 銷售之能力可能受影響。
現有成員在二級市場出售 VOIs，可能導致本公司銷售收入及利潤下降。
若用於時尚分潤貸款之信用指標（如違約率）惡化，可能對本公司時尚分潤貸款證券化計畫造成不利影響。
本公司管理契約之到期、終止或重新協議，可能對本公司現金流、收入及利潤造成不利影響。
與時段權買賣有關的詐欺或非法活動可能會使消費者放棄購買我們的產品。
第三方退場公司所有者活動增加可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響。
與VOI所有者、住戶協會及其他第三方之間的爭議可能會導致訴訟及/或失去管理契約。
住戶協會董事會未能收取足夠費用，或成員未能支付這些費用，可能會導致缺乏足夠資金以維護或改善我們管理的不動產。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務面臨許多風險，投資人於做出投資決定前應留意這些風險。這些風險包括但不限於下列各項：
•總體經濟及其他超出本公司控制範圍之因素；•全球經濟收縮或經濟成長率偏低；
•經營於高度競爭之產業；
•若本公司違反與希爾頓之授權協議，且希爾頓行使其協議所賦予之權利，可能對本公司業務造成重大損害，此等損害可能包括喪失某些權利（例如時尚俱樂部業務之獨佔權）或授權協議之終止；
•本公司使用希爾頓品牌與商標並重新品牌化鑽石與藍格林業務與資產之能力，以及若本公司未能履行此項義務，可能產生之後果；
•希爾頓品牌之品質與聲譽及與希爾頓榮譽忠誠計畫之合作關係；
